_comment: Template only: the CR/CF numbers and dates below are illustrative placeholders, not a real therapy schedule. Copy to settings.json and fill in your configured CamAPS schedules. Each parameter is a dated history; the entry with the latest effective_from <= analysis date wins. Block keys are HH-HH (24h); use a coarse key like 00-24 if a factor is constant across the day. CR is g per unit, CF is mg/dl per unit. insulin_action_hours is the duration of insulin action used for IOB (optional; defaults to 2).
